content.user_title: Clarify Project Intent Before You Build
content.value_statement: Ambiguous requests can create incorrect plans and wasted work. This skill asks focused questions to confirm goals, constraints, and success criteria before implementation.
actual_capabilities: Asks one focused question at a time for underspecified requests.
Identifies goals, users, constraints, tradeoffs, and success criteria.
Restates confirmed intent with explicit in-scope and out-of-scope work.
Checks whether approval is explicit rather than assumed.
Offers a user-confirmed handoff to refinement or specification work.
Can offer to save a confirmed intent record after user confirmation.
limitations: Requires a live user who can answer follow-up questions.
Does not create a technical design, implementation plan, or code.
Cannot verify whether user statements are accurate or complete.
Should not run in CI, scheduled tasks, or autonomous loops.

use_cases.title: Scope a new product request
use_cases.description: Clarify who needs the product, why it matters, and what success means before drafting requirements.

use_cases.title: Prepare an engineering handoff
use_cases.description: Confirm constraints and out-of-scope work before asking for a specification or implementation plan.

use_cases.title: Test an early idea
use_cases.description: Explore motivations and tradeoffs before investing time in a proposal or prototype.

prompt_templates.title: Start a basic interview
prompt_templates.prompt: Interview me about my request to build a team dashboard. Ask one question at a time until you can restate the intent.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner has a broad project idea.

prompt_templates.title: Clarify a feature request
prompt_templates.prompt: Interview me before planning a notification feature. Focus on users, urgency, channels, privacy, and success criteria.
prompt_templates.scenario: A team needs clear feature requirements.

prompt_templates.title: Resolve competing priorities
prompt_templates.prompt: Stress-test my request for a faster onboarding flow. Ask questions that expose tradeoffs between speed, compliance, and support needs.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a confirmed handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Interview me about replacing our reporting process. When intent is clear, provide an in-scope and out-of-scope summary for a specification writer.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced user needs a reliable downstream handoff.

output_examples.input: Interview me about a customer portal.
output: Question: Which customer group should the portal serve first?
Confirmed intent: Give existing enterprise customers a secure place to view invoices and support requests.
Out of scope: New sales, payment processing, and mobile applications.

output_examples.input: Clarify my request to automate weekly reports.
output: Question: Who uses the report, and what decision does it support?
Confirmed intent: Send operations leaders a weekly summary that highlights delivery delays.
Success criterion: Leaders identify urgent delays without manual spreadsheet review.

best_practices: Answer each question with concrete examples and constraints.
Ask for a confirmation summary before starting downstream work.
State tradeoffs and non-goals clearly when they matter.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill when no live user can respond.
Do not treat vague approval as confirmed intent.
Do not skip questions because an assumption seems obvious.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It runs a focused interview to clarify intent before planning or implementation.

faq.question: When should I use it?
faq.answer: Use it when a request lacks goals, users, constraints, or success criteria.

faq.question: Does it write code?
faq.answer: No. It prepares a clearer foundation for later planning or coding work.

faq.question: How does it ask questions?
faq.answer: It asks one question at a time and adapts based on each answer.

faq.question: Can it run without a user?
faq.answer: No. It requires a live user and should not run in automated workflows.

faq.question: Can it save the result?
faq.answer: It can offer to save confirmed intent only after the user agrees.
